about.headline: A Geospatial & Engineering Partner You Can Build On
about.description:
SmartGrid Surveying & Civil Works Ltd is a professional geospatial and engineering firm delivering precision land surveying, UAV mapping, GIS analysis, underground utility detection, and civil infrastructure solutions.

 From our base in Nairobi we serve government agencies, NGOs, private developers, and donor-funded programmes across Kenya and Africa — combining cutting-edge RTK GNSS, drone LiDAR, and total station technologies with disciplined project management to turn spatial data into confident decisions.
points: Licensed professional surveyors and engineers (EBK / ISK registered)
Donor-compliant delivery aligned to World Bank and UN standards
In-house UAV fleet with KCAA-certified remote pilots
Proven track record across 7+ African countries

items.title: Our Mission
items.description: To deliver precise, reliable, and actionable geospatial and engineering solutions that empower informed design, development, and land governance decisions.

items.title: Our Vision
items.description: To be Africa's most trusted surveying and civil engineering partner — where every decision is built on accurate spatial data and uncompromising integrity.

items.title: Core Values
items.description: Accuracy in every measurement. Integrity in every engagement. Safety on every site. Innovation in every workflow. Professionalism in every deliverable.

services.headline: Integrated Service Capabilities
services.description: One partner across the full project lifecycle — from reconnaissance to final deliverables.

items.title: Land Surveying
items.description: Topographical, cadastral, and boundary surveys with centimeter-level accuracy.

items.title: Aerial Drone Surveys
items.description: UAV photogrammetry and LiDAR mapping, volumetrics, and monitoring.

items.title: GIS & Spatial Analysis
items.description: Spatial databases, NDVI analytics, and cartographic deliverables.

items.title: Underground Utility Detection
items.description: GPR and electromagnetic locating for safe excavation and design.

items.title: Civil & Engineering Surveys
items.description: Setting out, as-built verification, and construction monitoring.

items.title: Volumetric Analysis
items.description: Stockpile quantities and cut/fill computations for mining and construction.
